_readme: Extra names under which a co-hosting organisation appears in the programme's host field.
Used only by explorer-embed.html to put the right logo next to an activity.
Key = the organisation's slug in the thjw repo (its logo is logos/<slug>.png there).
Value = the other spellings hosts use. Matching ignores case, accents and punctuation,
except for a single word with two or more capitals (an acronym such as HiiL), which must match exactly.
The organisation's own name, and an acronym in brackets after it, are matched without being listed here.
embassy-of-the-kingdom-of-the-netherland: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Colombia
